svg.title: Clark Farm: proposed pasture fencing with existing trees

g.inkscape:label: Title and legend
g.text: Clark Farm · Agriculture Education Center · stakeholder review draft
Edge of wooded area (survey tree line)
Trees: Seibert study plan A0.2 (campus) and survey A0.1 (rest of parcel), overlaid by matching
the CAD sheets (see tools/registration.json). Symbols are schematic, not canopy to scale.
Bonus pasture woodland was not part of the tree survey; canopy notes come from the pasture worksheet.
Scale calibrated to paddock acreages, approx. 1 in = 186 ft on the 36x24 sheet.
